PROGRAM
  MAPPING
    MAPPING_HEADER
      IDENT "Users"
      SHAPE_SEP ":"
      SHAPE_EXPR
        IDENT "Person"
      KW_FROM "from"
      EXPR
        LITERAL_EXPR
          IDENT "User"
    MAPPING_BODY
      PROPERTY
        PROPERTY_LHS
          AT_ATTR "@subject"
        ASSIGN "="
        EXPR
          PIPELINE_EXPR
            LITERAL_EXPR
              IDENT "User"
            PIPE "|>"
            POSTFIX_EXPR
              LITERAL_EXPR
                IDENT "filter"
              LPAREN "("
              ARG_LIST
                ARG
                  BINARY_EXPR
                    POSTFIX_EXPR
                      LITERAL_EXPR
                        IDENT "User"
                      DOT "."
                      IDENT "age"
                    GE ">="
                    LITERAL_EXPR
                      INTEGER "18"
              RPAREN ")"
